remarks: Enjoy resort-style living at this inviting two-story Lake Forest pool home, offering approximately 2,858 square feet of spacious living and exceptional outdoor entertainment. Custom pavers, stone accents and lush landscaping create a welcoming first impression. Inside, vaulted ceilings, wood flooring and a custom wood staircase with iron railing add warmth and architectural character. Separate living and family rooms, a formal dining room and a breakfast nook provide ample space for everyday living and gatherings.
